description: The workspace's plan and tier, when the billing period starts and renews, purchased credit left (total in cents, currency, and `display` as the amount to quote, or null), a custom deal's summary (state, dates, and quota granted, used and remaining each with `display`; or null), and each free allowance with what is used. Quote an amount by its `display` text exactly as returned; never add or convert amounts. Use when: someone asks what plan they are on, what it includes, when it renews or how much credit is left. Owner or billing admin only; other roles get 403. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this; an API key is refused.
name: getWorkspacePlan

outputSchema.description:
The workspace's plan, period, credit and free allowances. Amounts are
minor units of `currency`, exactly as auth gives them.

balanceLeft.description:
What is left to draw usage from, one line per name as the Billing
page lists it: a plan's licence, a free allocation, a pack. Drained
lines are left out. Quote `display`.

display.description: The amount left as the Billing page writes it.

credit.description:
Purchased credit left, as the Billing page shows it, or null when
the workspace has no billing account yet. Quote `display`.

display.description: The amount as the Billing page writes it.

deal.description:
A custom deal's summary, or null when there is no deal. Quota
amounts are minor units of `currency`; quote their `display`.
Per-minute rates are not included.

quota.description: The deal's money quota, or null when it cannot be shown.

display.description: The amount as the Billing page writes it. Quote this.

minor.description: Amount in minor units of the deal currency.

display.description: The amount as the Billing page writes it. Quote this.

minor.description: Amount in minor units of the deal currency.

display.description: The amount as the Billing page writes it. Quote this.

minor.description: Amount in minor units of the deal currency.

minutesLeft.description: Minutes left at the deal's rate for this service.

freePools.description:
The Free tier's monthly free allowances. Empty on any other plan,
where they are not counted down.

plan.description: The plan the workspace is on (auth's effectiveTier).

title: Get Plan and Allowances
